items.question: What kind of work do you take on?
items.answer: Production AI systems, ML infrastructure & MLOps, and LLM integration & orchestration — from architecture review and proof-of-concept to fully deployed, monitored, and scaled systems.

items.question: Are you available for contracts or full-time roles?
items.answer: Both. I'm currently open to consulting engagements and full-time positions. The fastest way to start is a short call to scope the problem.

items.question: Where are you based, and do you work remotely?
items.answer: I'm based in Noida, India, and work with distributed teams across time zones. Remote-first, with occasional on-site as needed.

items.question: What does a typical engagement look like?
items.answer: It usually starts with an architecture and reliability review, then a tightly-scoped build phase with clear latency, uptime, and cost targets — followed by observability and handoff so your team can own it.
